lines: If you're worried about someone stealing items from your
bank, why not protect yourself with a Bank PIN?
A Bank PIN is a four-digit number. It's like a password that
protects your bank account. If you set one, you'll be asked to
enter it before you can take items out of the bank.
If you're interested, speak to the bankers and ask about Bank
But remember, KEEP YOUR PIN SECRET!
